issues.detail: The Greek verb 'παρακαλουμεν' (parakaloumen) means 'we are beseeching/pleading/supplicating'. The Vietnamese translation 'khuyên bảo' means 'to advise/counsel', which changes the nature of the action from a plea to an instruction.

The Greek 'περικαθαρματα' (perikatharmata) implies 'refuse' or 'scum' (something cast off), while 'đồ dơ bẩn' simply means 'dirty things'. While related, the Greek specifically denotes something rejected/discarded.
